title: Structure engineering reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it 48px as it scrolls into view, with an optional step for staggered rows. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation; static and motion-reduced visitors see it in place.
notes: don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box: use overflow-clip, or the timeline freezes
name: structureengineering-reveal

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (div by default; li inside lists, span inside headings)

props.name: step
props.description: position in a staggered group: 0, 1, 2… each arrives a little later

props.name: rise
props.description: how far it rises, in px (the original uses 48)
